title: What Scripture Actually Says About Killing Sin (It's Not Trying Harder)
caption:
What Scripture says about killing sin isn't “try harder.”

Romans 8:13: if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live. By the Spirit. Not by grit.

Name the sin. Starve the supply. Bring a brother in. God finishes what He starts.

What have you been managing that God told you to kill?
